fieldNotes.location: Resolved with high confidence. Roster geocode (movedMeters 5133) lands directly on the long cross-dock RDC building at 5200 SW Wenger Drive, Topeka KS 66609. Confirmed as HD RDC #5024 via SupplierWiki and Waze ("The Home Depot Rapid Deployment Center").
fieldNotes.truckGate: truckGate true with high confidence. A single curved truck access road runs up from SW Wenger Drive to the trailer yard; it is the only vehicle entry and pinches into a controlled gate where it meets the fenced yard. Trucks observed staged along the access road in Street View. Perimeter chain-link fencing encloses the trailer yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Gate is confirmed present; a discrete guard booth was not unambiguously isolated from imagery — guardShack set true per the HD-RDC norm of staffed gate check-in, but listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock RDC: dock doors run along both long faces; receiving and shipping operate from separate dock banks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large trailer drop yard south of the building — long rows holding 200+ trailers without tractors. dropArea 50+.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural — the site is on the southern edge of Topeka, with active farmland immediately north of the building and open country around; an industrial park sits adjacent but the broader setting is edge-of-town.
fieldNotes.railServed: false — no rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is not connected.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~120 estimate across both long elevations of a ~550K sq ft RDC; backed-in trailers obscure exact count.
fieldNotes.extra: A Plug Power hydrogen fuel station for fuel-cell forklifts sits at the building's office/SW side — a hallmark of HD RDC operations, corroborating HD tenancy.
